description: This file is the entry point for a React web application; it imports React, ReactDOM's createRoot, the main App component, and global styles. It initializes the React app by rendering the App component inside a strict mode wrapper into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: Main execution block
methods.description: Initializes the React application by selecting the DOM element with id 'root', creating a React root, and rendering the App component wrapped in React.StrictMode.
